title: Silver Days
description: A performant 1.7.10 modpack with only one content mod (Et Futurum Requiem).
body:
This modpack is not designed to be a kitchen sink or expert modpack. This modpack exists to serve as a solid base for those that enjoy playing Minecraft 1.7.10, with only Et Futurum Requiem adding anything to the game compared to vanilla.
Et Futurum Requiem has had some small config changes, to make systems work a bit more like 1.7.10 and less like modern versions.
**NOTE**: This modpack uses lwjgl3ify, which means you will want to have a newer version of Java (preferably version 21 Temurin) on your computer. [SDKMAN!](https://sdkman.io/) is an easy way to do this.
